working_definition: Author cell type 'T neuron T4/T5a-b' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 1525 cells): T4/T5 neurons of subtypes a and b (lobula plate layers 1 and 2); authors' terms T4a, T4b, T5a, T5b.
searches_performed: ancestors of T4a/T4b/T5a/T5b via EBI OLS4

best_match.fbbt_definition: Intrinsic columnar neuron of the optic lobe that has its cell body in the posterior part of the optic lobe and a cell body fiber that bifurcates in the second optic chiasma (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989).

justification: Grouped call spanning T4a, T4b, T5a, T5b. T4 and T5 are siblings under T neuron, and no FBbt class groups the a/b subtypes across T4 and T5, so T neuron is the most specific common parent (T4a ancestry verified).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1.
T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2.
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1.
T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2.

recommendation: Broad match to T neuron; four members listed.
